title: 第3262章 天阶神帝的传承第3261章 突破中阶神帝
lines: 昔寻悦，昆墟兽山的帝族大妖！
当初在灵壤古原之时，她和堕灵门的封夜罗一同站在萧诺的对立面。
当时即便两人联手，也未能打败萧诺。
最后，封夜罗惨遭萧诺斩杀。
而昔寻悦则是趁机逃走。
如今在这里遇到，正常情况下，昔寻悦要绕道走才对。
没想到的是，对方竟然还敢主动来到萧诺身边。
昔寻悦秀眉轻挑，她笑道：“以萧公子的能耐，你若真要杀我，我也逃不掉……”
事实上，萧诺刚到这里，就已经感知到了昔寻悦的气息。
还有青苍宗那几个人，萧诺也早就发现了。
不过，萧诺倒也没有为难昔寻悦。
因为没有那个必要。
毕竟现在的萧诺，已经和青苍宗没有任何的关系了。
自己欠青苍宗的人情，全部还完。
而且这份人情就相当于青苍宗给了萧诺一棵树，萧诺归还了他们一片大森林。
萧诺平静的说道：“我的确懒得杀你，但这并不意味你可以过来主动挑衅我，如果你昆墟兽山还想揪着不放，我萧诺不介意重新开战！”
昔寻悦连忙说道：“萧诺公子误会了，我可没有别的意思，我就是过来跟你说会话，解除一下以前的恩怨。”
“哦？”萧诺反问道：“我杀了你昆墟兽山那么多人，你也就这么算了？”
昔寻悦道：“萧公子实力通天，我们昆墟兽山可不想步了堕灵门的后尘。”
萧诺没有搭理对方。
昔寻悦再道：“对了萧公子，你可知这座石碑的来历？”
萧诺不语。
昔寻悦接着道：“萧公子是从下界来的，对于承天神域应该不是很了解，这座石碑据说是‘千狩神帝’留下的传承，那‘千狩神帝’生前可是一位‘天阶神帝’哦，他留下的东西，必然引来多方争抢！”
千狩神帝？
天阶神帝？
听到昔寻悦所言，萧诺眼中倒是流露出了几分兴致！
萧诺淡淡的问道：“石碑里边有什么传承？”
见到萧诺主动询问，昔寻悦不由的明媚一笑，这是她希望看到的，一旦萧诺愿意和自己交流，说明对方和昆墟兽山的恩怨是可以调节的。
昔寻悦是个聪明的人。
当初在灵壤古原的时候，她就很重视萧诺，她当时还想着把萧诺拉拢到昆墟兽山，结果遭到了萧诺的拒绝。
堕灵门被灭后，更是让昔寻悦产生了一种危机感。
她知道，不能继续让双方的关系恶化下去，不然的话，昆墟兽山早晚要变成第二个堕灵门。
所以刚才昔寻悦也是鼓足了勇气，上来到萧诺搭话。
但凡一个不小心，都有可能被萧诺一剑给劈了。
昔寻悦回答道：“石碑里边大概率是‘千狩神帝’留下的一部绝世神技，至于是什么神技，我也不得而知，毕竟这座‘石碑’还是第一次出现，以往万族战场开启的时候，并未出现过。”
与此同时，
青苍宗那边，众人的目光也是聚集在了昔寻悦的身上。
“那人好像是昆墟兽山的人！”年朝禹喃喃低语道。
闻言，青苍宗几人的神情皆是有所变化。
content_en:
Xi Xunyue, the great demon of the Imperial Clan from Kunxu Beast Mountain!
Back when she was in Linglang Ancient Plain, she and Feng Yeluo from the Fallen Spirit Sect stood on the opposite side of Xiao Nuo.
Even if the two of them joined forces at that time, they could not defeat Xiao Nuo.
In the end, Feng Yeluo was brutally killed by Xiao Nuo.
Xi Xunyue took the opportunity to escape.
Now that we met here, under normal circumstances, Xi Xunyue would have taken a detour.
Unexpectedly, the other party actually dared to come to Xiao Nuo.
Xi Xunyue raised her beautiful eyebrows lightly and said with a smile: "With Master Xiao's ability, if you really want to kill me, I won't be able to escape..."
In fact, Xiao Nuo had already sensed Xi Xunyue's aura as soon as he arrived here.
As for those people from Qingcang Sect, Xiao Nuo had also discovered them a long time ago.
However, Xiao Nuo did not make things difficult for him.
Because there is no need for that.
After all, Xiao Nuo no longer has anything to do with Qingcang Sect.
All the favors I owe to the Qingcang Sect have been repaid.
And this favor is equivalent to Qingcang Sect giving Xiao Nuo a tree, and Xiao Nuo returning a big forest to them.
Xiao Nuo said calmly: "I am indeed too lazy to kill you, but that doesn't mean you can come over and provoke me. If you still want to hold on to Kunxu Beast Mountain, I, Xiao Nuo, don't mind starting the war again!"
Xi Xunyue said quickly: "Master Xiao Nuo misunderstood, I have no other intentions. I just came to have a conversation with you and resolve the previous grudges."
"Oh?" Xiao Nuo asked back: "I killed so many people in Kunxu Beast Mountain, so you just let it go?"
Xi Xunyue said: "Master Xiao is extremely powerful, and we at Kunxu Beast Mountain don't want to follow in the footsteps of the Fallen Spirit Sect."
Xiao Nuo ignored the other party.
Xi Xunyue said again: "By the way, Mr. Xiao, do you know the origin of this stone tablet?"
Xiao Nuo was silent.
Xi Xunyue continued: "Young Master Xiao is from the lower world, and he probably doesn't know much about the Chengtian Divine Realm. This stone tablet is said to be the inheritance left by the 'Qian Shou God Emperor'. The 'Qian Shou God Emperor' was a 'Heaven-level God Emperor' during his lifetime. The things he left behind will inevitably attract many parties to fight for them!"
Qian Shou God Emperor?
Heavenly God Emperor?
After hearing what Xi Xunyue said, Xiao Nuo's eyes showed a bit of interest!
Xiao Nuo asked lightly: "What inheritance is contained in the stone tablet?"
Seeing Xiao Nuo taking the initiative to ask, Xi Xunyue couldn't help but smile brightly. This was what she wanted to see. Once Xiao Nuo was willing to communicate with her, it meant that the grievances between the other party and Kunxu Beast Mountain could be adjusted.
Xi Xunyue is a smart person.
She had attached great importance to Xiao Nuo when she was in Lingrang Ancient Plains. At that time, she was still thinking of recruiting Xiao Nuo to Kunxu Beast Mountain, but she was rejected by Xiao Nuo.
After the Fallen Spirit Sect was destroyed, Xi Xunyue felt a sense of crisis.
She knew that she could not continue to let the relationship between the two parties deteriorate, otherwise, sooner or later, Kunxu Beast Mountain would become the second Fallen Soul Sect.
So just now Xi Xunyue mustered up the courage to come up and talk to Xiao Nuo.
If you are not careful, you may be struck by Xiao Nuo's sword.
Xi Xunyue replied: "There is a high probability that the stone tablet contains a peerless magical skill left by the 'Thousand Hunting God Emperor'. As for what magical skill it is, I don't know. After all, this is the first time that this 'stone tablet' has appeared. It has never appeared before when the Ten Thousand Races Battlefield was opened."
…
At the same time,
At the Qingcang Sect, everyone's eyes were also focused on Xi Xunyue.
"That person seems to be from Kunxu Beast Mountain!" Nian Chaoyu murmured.
Hearing this, the expressions of the Qingcang Sect members all changed.
